Obie | Chicago, IL (Hybrid Tue/Thu) or Remote (US) | Full-time | Product Manager; Technical Project Manager (TPM) | https://ats.rippling.com/obie/jobs/76234395-2934-4746-a421-5..., https://ats.rippling.com/obie/jobs/4891a38c-9a69-47fa-9cc7-8...

Obie is an insurtech building modern software and tooling for a heavily regulated industry. We ship customer-facing product and internal platforms that handle complex workflows, partner constraints, and real-world edge cases — with a strong emphasis on systems thinking, product quality, and moving quickly without being reckless.

Roles: - Product Manager (platform with multiple surfaces/users/channels; strong product taste + technical curiosity) - Technical Project Manager (end-to-end delivery across engineering pods; scope/tradeoffs/dependencies/release readiness)

Apply via the links above. More info: https://www.obieinsurance.com/careers
